messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Sutton Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi Julie,

Thanks for coming back to me. No problem at all on 2026, I'll release Saturday 7 November.

For a two hour show Jake would normally start at 9pm and finish at 11.30pm, with a half hour break in the middle. If you'd rather keep your usual 8.30 to 11.30 format with three sets, he's happy to do that too. Three sets is £350, or £300 a night if you book four.

For 2027 I'm still holding Saturday 27 March, Saturday 5 June and Saturday 11 December for you. Would any of those work?

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex

messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Sutton Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi Julie,

No apology needed, you read it right the first time. It's £250 cash a night when you book four, for Jake's two hour show, 9pm to 11.30pm with a half hour break. Same price every night.

For 2027 I can hold Saturday 27 March, Saturday 5 June and Saturday 11 December, plus one more that suits you. Just say which dates and I'll pop them in the diary.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
